d2313.Raw_Article: 2313 Ka. jaḍḍa nearness, union; jaḍḍakkara one consonant written below another; daḍḍa closeness, union; daḍḍakkara a compound or double consonant; daṇḍe state of being adjoining or close by, vicinity. Te. jaḍḍa a compound consonant; (B. also) near, close by, connected with; daṇḍa nearness, proximity, side. DED(S) 1909.
